item.title: Bulletin updated at 00:00 HKT 07/May/2022
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Upper-air disturbances will bring a few showers to southern China in the next couple of days. A trough of low pressure is expected to bring unsettled weather to Guangdong in the middle and latter parts of next week, there will be heavy showers and squally thunderstorms over the region. The northeast monsoon will affect the coast of Guangdong during the weekend next week, temperatures will fall slightly over the region.
